dataset: eleven agent-authored synthetic questions; prior developer work and tool names were known; independent human review pending
source: AgentService.step only; no actual tools dispatched, no Java auth or business state
fixed: same question, allowed scope, step zero, empty observation history, same AgentService validation and handoff guards; local model Qwen 4B Q4_K_M, context 4096, 256 output tokens, temperature 0.2, seed 42; no retry
arguments: exact job ID, exact scope/top_k and nonempty knowledge query; semantic query relevance is not evaluated
handoff: model-independent regex guard may bypass model; record model call count to distinguish guard from model behavior
forbidden: count only validated public tool intents outside closed read allowlist; model raw text and actual tool execution are not evaluated
metrics: valid coverage, expected kind/tool/argument match, guard-bypass count, forbidden public intents, p50/p95 latency; provider local billed $0, energy not measured
